title: Generate native 30-second shots in Seedance 2.5 instead of stitching shorter…
content:
Generate native 30-second shots in Seedance 2.5 instead of stitching shorter clips.  
Use up to 50 reference images/videos to maintain character/style consistency across shots.  
Use Flova Agent to auto-plan your script and storyboard before generating scenes.  
Apply Flova’s 100+ professional Skills to assemble multiple shots into videos up to 5 minutes.
